beats.say: Arsenal went 80 minutes without a shot on target. Then they won.
At Nottingham Forest, Noni Madueke finally hit the target in the 80th minute.
His strike took a big deflection off a Forest defender and flew past the goalkeeper.
And it was worth far more than one goal.
That was Arsenal's first shot on target all game, and it was the only goal.
It keeps Arsenal second, three points behind leaders Manchester City, while Forest stay in the bottom three.
One shot on target. Three points.
